task: static_file() gets conditional requests wrong when a client sends both If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since. RFC 7232 section 3.3 says If-Modified-Since must be ignored whenever If-None-Match is present. So if If-None-Match does not match the file's ETag (say it is "no-match") and If-Modified-Since would count as fresh, the response must be 200, not 304. If If-None-Match equals the current ETag, the response stays 304 even when If-Modified-Since is old. Requests with only If-Modified-Since keep working as they do now.
